  2. Udemy - has a vast collection of online courses on art and drawing.
  3. Drawabox - a free online drawing course covering the basics of drawing.
  4. New Masters Academy - offers online courses and tutorials on drawing, painting, and sculpture.
  5. Ctrl+Paint - a free online drawing course covering the basics of digital painting and drawing.
